Jammy Muffins
By: Melissa Peterman
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 12:04am

Ingredients




2 tablespoons  Vegetable Oil
1/4 cup Raw honey
2 cups Whole Grain Bran Muffin Mix
1 Egg beaten or egg replacer
1 cup Water
1 cup Apple Butter

Preparation

1 Prepare Whole Grain Bran Muffin Mix according to package directions. 2 Before baking, spoon 1 teaspoon apple butter (or favorite flavor) into center of the unbaked muffin.
 3  Bake at 350 degrees F. for 25-30 minutes.

About


Feel free to use jelly, jam or preserves instead of apple butter.
